name: B · 丹霞镇符
summary: 短髻露额 · 斜襟短装 · 果断英气
detail: A decisive energetic protective Taoist, distinct broad squared-oval face, thick short flat brows, open focused graphic eyes, a tiny closed confident grin, no makeup. Dark black SHORT hair swept firmly off forehead into ONE very small upright clipped dao topknot with plain wooden pin, close side hair and exposed near ear, no large ponytail/flowing silver hair. CINNABAR red/ivory/charcoal with muted bronze. Costume is a SHORT practical asymmetric wrap jacket, wide ivory diagonal lapel supporting fuller feminine bust, broad dark waist cinch, ONE broad hanging sleeve at rear side and opposite fitted short sleeve/bracer, two short angular hip tabs over charcoal tapered trousers, cream shin wraps and simple red-brown low boots. Big angular lightning-like cinnabar brush motif only on one sleeve edge, not repeated glyphs everywhere. Distinct strong TRIANGULAR/diagonal silhouette. POSE shallow forward step/lunge facing left, forward hand extends two fingers together in a clear spell gesture, other hand low behind/side holds ONE short peach-wood ritual sword diagonally down with complete wooden blade and small cloud-shaped guard, one talisman paper fastened to hilt and one short red cord away from fingers. No metal sword, no staff, no fan. Mature feminine form powerful but not muscular; sleeves/tabs sweep slightly right with action. Ritual sword has bold warm wood planes, two clear joints, not tiny carvings.
